decisions.reason: As a wood-floor cleaning soap that builds directly on the firm's surface-treatment and aftercare know-how, it is easy to evaluate, refine, and sell through existing customer channels.
The maintenance oil fits closely with the firm's established expertise in wooden floor performance and care, so the firm is well placed to learn from early use and improve it through its own R&D.

Although somewhat overlapping with other care products, it still rests on the firm's existing knowledge of oiled wood floors and supports a full-system offer that German flooring firms typically value.

A moisture-protection underlay is a strong complement to the core flooring business, and the firm's technical guidance and installation knowledge make commercial application and iterative improvement straightforward.
The high-density underlay foam remains close enough to the installation system that the firm can absorb market feedback effectively and use it to strengthen bundled flooring solutions.
An oak parquet floor is closest to the firm's core manufacturing and design capabilities, making it the product with the strongest knowledge fit and the lowest likelihood of withdrawal.
